name: Local Trade LCT
cause: Improper Access Control of Close-source contract
report: The root cause of the issue was the absence of a permission check in the function 0xb5863c10. This function can be called by anyone, allowing them to modify the owner. The attacker took advantage of this vulnerability by setting himself as the owner.
report_zh: 问题的根本原因是0xb5863c10函数缺少权限检查。任何人都可调用此函数，从而允许他们修改owner。攻击者利用此漏洞将自己设置为owner。
